notes: Nicer text colours + Paste Style stays put. Scene view now uses the same colour swatches as the timeline inspector for the main text and each text overlay — a row of quick-pick presets plus a round custom-colour swatch, instead of the small default colour boxes. And 'Paste Style' no longer jumps you back to the top of the page: it keeps you on the scene you just pasted onto. Also rolls in recent fixes: background Brightness/Contrast (v1.5.3), Align H/V keep the other axis (v1.5.2), and updates no longer open a duplicate browser tab (v1.5.1).
